raw:
Lewis Hamilton won the 2018 Azerbaijan Grand Prix at the Baku City Circuit on 29 April 2018. He started from 2nd on the grid. Kimi Räikkönen was second and Sergio Pérez third.

ANSWER: Lewis Hamilton
